decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - All new internal and external works, including works of making good, shall match the original work in both type, colour and dimensions of materials and in detailed execution.

Condition : 3 - Before the relevant part of the works is commenced, a scheme shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority showing details of specifications of the works to the countyer where the screen is being removed, and the size/nature of the vent being installed in the original wall next to the bar. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
Condition : 4 - All new work shall be of appropriate quality and appearance to the age and character of the listed building.
description: Internal alterations, repair & replacement of timber flooring & external decorations and repair works (like for like) to existing Public House (Listed Building Consent)
